Record notes

Fourteen methods for project structure, delivery, plugin maintenance, GitHub, vaults and cross-host exchange.

Version 0.3.2 includes 14 complete skill procedures. Complete methods, helpers and opt-in hooks; personal profile, goals and logs replaced by recipient templates.

Requirements: Host file and coding tools; Explicit receiving-host bindings for optional helpers.

License scope: AGPL-3.0-only AND CC-BY-SA-4.0; retained upstream licenses as scoped in LICENSE-SCOPE.json. Read the packaged notices and provenance before reuse.

Install with codex plugin add work-management@working-tools after adding JonathanKHobson/working-tools-plugins, or the documented Claude Code marketplace path. Installation and tested compatibility.

This ZIP keeps its portable manifest at the root and preserves the referenced package files. This release includes a separate per-file hash inventory. Built from 7d32c283e34098403c5ffdacbeee7bed57a4ac8f. SHA-256: 7c26bfeb342dfc7d51c9229d9b853feb95320b9b2ed8eb687f5181459218d5a7.

Native marketplace distribution is separate from official OpenAI Plugin Directory publication. External provider access remains a prerequisite.
